ITEM 1 | Crumbly golden-brown granular coating, tan to light brown with darker toasted spots, dry and sandy-textured, scattered across the center and right side of a white square plate, roughly 40 percent of plate surface and about 1 cm thick in clumps | 45
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green leafy pieces with wilted, slightly glossy surfaces, some translucent and creamy-looking, forming a loose heap in the lower-left of the plate, about 12 cm across and 1 to 2 cm tall | 40
ITEM 3 | Dark green curly leaves with ruffled edges, matte to slightly glossy, held in a cluster in the upper-center of the plate, roughly 10 cm across and 1 cm tall | 25
ITEM 4 | Bright green broad leaves with soft, slightly wilted texture and a faint sheen, lying on the right side of the plate, about 8 cm long and under 1 cm thick | 20
ITEM 5 | Dark brown to charred-looking pieces with rough edges, scattered among the crumbs and greens, about 1 to 2 cm each, dry-looking | 8
ITEM 6 | Small loose crumbs of tan-brown coating dispersed around the plate rim and on the left side, dry and crumbly, each under 0.5 cm | 3
